reviews.text:
Our cat Charlie need digit removal for a soft tissue sarcoma. He is 15 1/2 years old. I was on the fence about doing the operation, Dr.Emmerich walked me through every step of the process answering all my nervous questions. Dr Fried who did the surgery is a compassionate, knowledgeable surgeon. He gave Charlie the absolute expertise care. The entire team was so helpful.
Charlie is on the road to recovery, I am glad we went to RVG

tried to make an appt not very polite or welcoming for a first time pet owner & trying to make an appt …so i decided to read the reviews and see if it’s worth it and im overreacting but im not wrong… def will take my services elsewhere
I have been using them since 2001 and I am very impressed with the care and professionalism they show.
Love this place. Dr. Fried is awesome, very knowledgeable & understanding The staff is amazing.

I’ve been bringing my now 9 yr old pitbull mix here since I moved to the neighborhood in 2022, and I’ve also been bringing my second dog (my now 3 yr old shepherd mix) here since 2023. My husband and I have  pet insurance for both dogs. The veterinarians in this place are fantastic and have excellent communication with pet parents. They caught a heart murmur in my senior dog and have helped us with her chronic pancreatitis. My younger pup had a stubborn bout of Giardia when we first got him from a rescue as a puppy and we were able to get him well with this clinics help.

I know some people complain about not being able to go into the back exam room with their pets to see the doctor, but I feel my dogs probably behave better when I’m not in the room for their exam (as I’m sure is the case for most dogs even if they’re parents won’t admit it). My dogs are never overly stressed about going with a tech to be taken to the back, so that indicates to me that the animals are treated perfectly fine back there. I also appreciate talking to the doctor without my hyper younger dog present to distract me from the conversation.

The prices for treatment have never been surprising or seemed too high. This is a great place to take your pet for well thought out care, I’d recommend it to anyone.

If you love your pet, I’d urge you not to bring them here. My dog Wally has been coming to this vet for as long as I know. Everytime he had a checkup, they’d tell us he was perfectly healthy. Wally was not perfectly healthy. He could barely keep is food down and was throwing up after every meal. The vet would suggest giving him a certain diet, which didn’t help, or prescribed him medication, which also didn’t help. We took him to another vet who finally told us he had a heart murmur and had to be put down. How could the vets here be so irresponsible??? If they did proper examinations with all the money I’ve spent on trying to figure out what’s wrong with Wally, he’d be here now.
Excellent veterinarians

After 6+ years of coming here i can tell you they’re not good professionals. They didn’t bothered to throughly diagnose my dog and FF 3 weeks later he’s a mess and we got a bigger problem now. Their response was “sorry you feel this way”. They’re not in for animal welfare but charging an absurd amount of cash for who knows what, since they take your pet to the back and you cannot even get a clue if they *actually* checked him - not to mention that they rush and make you feel like you owe them a favor once you see the vet to get their feedback. Disaster!
Thank you so you help my baby Tinkerbell is doing much better

UPDATE: In the past I made an honest review for this vet. Its evident that this clinic took it seriously because in the past few months, I’ve been coming back to this vet and the service has been amazing. I’ll need to come back to update this review with the names of the people who have helped me. I don’t even know why I decided to come back here after a year, but I am very happy and satisfied that I gave this place a second chance. The nurses and the doctors are super smart. In my last review my issue came more so from the front desk people. I work in the hospital and the first face/service patients get are from the front. It’s extremely important that you don’t have “nasty” attitudes greeting pet owners at the door. Anyway, the people in the front seem to be all new or at least they have better attitudes. Oh and the prices seem to have went back to affordable. Very very happy. Will be coming back.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: The staff in the back are very nice and friendly. There’s maybe ONE staffer in the front who is incredibly sweet. Other than that the service isn’t great, especially not for what they charge here. I’ve been going here for a little while and they made me feel like I could only ever get this kind of service only at this clinic, however I’ve been going to another vet and the difference in service/price is amazing (At the other clinic not this one)!! This clinic is a MONEY GRAB! But what do you expect it’s Riverdale haha it’s convenient, yes, but everyone in this neighborhood has a bad story with these people so….Anyway I don’t know why they have a high rating on google…seems VERY sus to me but you can get the real story on yelp where they have a 2 rating.

They don't allow an owner to be in the room for end of life services?!?!? That is horrifying and disrespectful!! The last thing a pet wants to see is their pet owner's face to keep them calm, not a stranger's
Brought my baby for cremation and the receptionist was so compassionate and sympathetic. Worth every penny to come here

I wanted to share a sincere note of appreciation following my recent visits.

Yesterday, I left feeling very upset due to an uncomfortable interaction at the front desk. However, I felt it was important to follow up today because my dog Luna is currently going through a serious gastrointestinal illness. This past month has been extremely stressful, with ER visits, specialists, and constant care for my baby girl. It has been emotionally and financially draining.

That said, today’s experience truly changed my perspective.

Dr. Fried and his assistant Danny were incredibly accommodating, patient, and compassionate. Their calm and reassuring approach meant more than I can express during such a frightening time. When you’re caring for a sick pet, kindness and reassurance matter just as much as treatment.

I also want to acknowledge the receptionist today, who was very warm and thoughtful. I was worried about having Luna sit in the waiting area with other dogs, and a kind staff member (I wish I had gotten her name) offered to bring us into a room right away. That small gesture made a big difference in keeping Luna comfortable and reducing my stress.

Additionally, I truly appreciated the fairness and transparency of today’s pricing. During ongoing medical care, it means a lot to feel supported rather than overwhelmed. Today felt compassionate and humane, and I’m very grateful.

Thank you, Dr. Fried, Danny, and the kind receptionist who helped us today. Your empathy and professionalism did not go unnoticed, and it meant so much during a very difficult time.

Agree with other reviews, it’s strange you can’t go in with your dog for their exam and that you need to talk to the Vet or tech in the hallway to discuss the exam. What if you forgot to mention one thing to check, they would then need to go back in the room with your dog and then come back out to discuss it with you?

Also, the fact you have to call in to get a call back later in the day for test results feels so disorganized.

Lastly, if you wanted to process medication through somewhere like Chewy, you have to mail in a paper prescription to Chewy and then wait a couple days for it to be processed before they send anything out.

An exam with Blood and urine work cost $700.

I am honestly sad to leave this review but I am done this Veterinary group and will be going elsewhere. After reading the fellow negative reviews I have decided to also leave my input as I have experienced the same things.

This vet has to be a money grab. The most insane prices I have ever heard!! They told me around $6-7,000 for a spade for my new kitty. How can anyone afford that?? I don’t know if that’s normal, but let’s also factor in that getting your cat looked at by the doctor ALONE is $200 not considering any blood work meds, anesthesia etc.

Also….One thing that bothers me Immensely is how they refuse to allow you in an exam room with your pet. I have been with this vet a long time, pre covid, so I know that they adopted this rule during the pandemic and stuck with it. I find it outrageous that I am not aloud to see what is being done to my baby!!! This is my child!!! I won’t be rude or discredit any doctor, but I do want to witness how my baby is treated. Not to mention they wouldn’t even allow me to be in the room while my cat was being put down. Such a sensitive procedure and I am still not aloud to be there??? not to mention it was also gona cost me a good 1k +…to pay that without my presence to calm my baby ??? absolutely not I found a group online who went to my house for $600 and I was able to hold my baby for his last breathes.

As someone who once loved this place, had most of my animals come. I highly recommend you GOING SOMEWHERE ELSE. They are rude at the front desk with horrible attitudes, and the female doctor judges you. BEWARE OF THIS PLACE 0 STARS .

Wow terrible customer service ! Calling to ask a question the lady is barking at me telling me don’t yell at me miss I am not yelling just asking you a question then she hangs up the phone I call back a guy answers which doesn’t even help and he also hangs up the phone on my oh my terrible horrible customer service  how can a business run like this !
Good doctors. Grumpy receptionist.

I do not recommend this veterinary group at all. I had been using them for my dog for 3 years and they have been consistently rude & extremely unaccommodating. The 2 times my dog has needed an urgent appointment they could not be bothered to fit him in. They also price gauge & just do not seem to care about animals at all. Take your beloved fur babies anywhere else!
When there's no hope this Vet works miracles.

It’s a great place.  If you need something of serious nature done I recommend the VEG group but this is the best in riverdale. I’m a local professional pet sitter Friendly Paws (on google as well) and many of my clients come here as well.
One of the best places ever
This place is beautiful and very clean. Super friendly and easy to make an appointment for your fur baby, very affordable even in an emergency. So grateful I was able to find them
The vets are still following COVID like protocol where they take your pet to a back room for the exam and treatment. It feels impersonal, and I prefer being in the room with my pet.
Great experience with this veterinary clinic! Staff are very friendly and helpful, doctors are very knowledgeable.
Fyi:I visited the vet not the animal hospital in Riverdale . That review applied to this place. Thanks. I do not know why i was asked about the hospital
It is 2:19PM, and the office is not open.

Service and prices are just OK… Front desk Staff are rude, condescending and overall just terrible for no reason. I’ve also seen three different doctors in the past month, I don’t like that inconsistency.

Same day service they took my lil man in and attended to his needs ASAP can say enough about Vets. Are very attractive to your words about your pet and recommend actions to be taken, love the staff and very inexpensive ❤️
Very nice and helpful receptionists,  attentive and highly skilled veterinarians.    I feel that they do care about my cat and suggest and do the best.
We’ve been coming here for years with our dogs, and most recently had our puppy neutered. He is recovering beautifully and everyone was so kind and caring throughout the process.

I appreciate the affordability and customer service!
I do have reservations about the conversations being so open and public as everyone sits in the waiting room and the owners don’t go back with the pets. I felt weird overhearing everyone’s business with their animals. But overall was very pleased with them!

I had an extremely disappointing experience at this veterinary clinic. My dog was very sick, and not only was he misdiagnosed, but I was also charged for the wrong assessment. The staff clearly lacked the knowledge and experience to properly care for him. I had to bring him back multiple times because they couldn’t figure out what was wrong, and each visit felt like a guessing game at my expense.

On top of that, I experienced disrespectful and racially insensitive behavior from the staff. As a paying client, I expected to be treated with professionalism and empathy, especially in a place that’s supposed to care for animals and their owners—but that was not the case here.

What shocked me most was how the clinic handled things afterward. The owner personally called me later that day to tell me I was no longer welcome and to never return to her clinic because they felt “disrespected”—after I had been the one mistreated and ignored. I had every right to be upset as a client who paid for inadequate care and poor treatment.

Additionally, I was very uncomfortable with how they repeatedly took my dog to the back room for exams, even though there were perfectly usable exam tables and rooms where I could have been present. The process felt secretive, and the place is very unhygienic. I had no idea what was being done to my dog, which is unacceptable and concerning.

This entire experience left me feeling frustrated, disrespected, and worried for my dog’s well-being. I would never recommend this clinic to anyone. If you value competent care, transparency, and being treated like a human being—go elsewhere.

Extremely disappointed with my experience at this veterinary clinic. The staff was not only unprofessional but also made me feel incredibly uncomfortable with their attitude and comments. I witnessed behavior that was clearly discriminatory, and it’s deeply troubling to see that kind of mindset in a place that’s supposed to be compassionate and caring. It’s clear this attitude comes from the top, as the owners were no better. I would never trust my pet’s care to people who treat others with such disrespect. I highly recommend looking elsewhere for a vet who actually respects all clients and animals equally.
Joshua is amazing with the animals.

I understand and agree with some of the concerns reviewers left about how they don’t let you in with them for exams, etc.. However, they were very thorough and helped with all the needs of my fur baby who just passed at 21 years old and I’m grateful for all the vets taking good care of her always and were respectful of my wishes and concerns regarding her not being over vaccinated at her age.

I had an awful experience here:

1) All pet problems get talked about in front of everyone in the waiting room, so don't expect privacy--this was pretty unusual
2) You don't get to watch them handle your dog; actually, they took a blood test from my dog without asking me (when my dog was with them in the private room) and then later we determined it was not a necessary procedure (heart worm test, had already had one the same year)
3) The vet offered to "price-match" meds which felt very car-salesman-y. What is this, Walmart?
4) The vet had "forgotten his prescription pad" so I needed to come back if I wanted the script
5) $80 for a visit
6) I was worried about my rescue's teeth and the vet told me my dog's teeth were fine--a few weeks later they started falling out and her next vet recommended removing 11 of them. Her teeth and breath are excellent now and she seems to be in far less pain
7) I was worried about my rescue's anxiety (she had had a rough life) and asked about puppy prozac. The vet patronizingly asked me, "Is this your first dog? Just buy her a toy. She'll become addicted to prozac." Her next vet prescribed a low dose of prozac and she's done amazing with it

The clinic was clean and the front desk were very welcoming. The veterinarians were very caring and loving. I will be going back with my doggy. He felt safe and was very happy when he got out. Super happy. Will be back in 3 weeks.
They are very good and explained me all the issues regarding the health of my doggie! The front desk staff is very friendly!!
They have been taking care of Enzo since the beginning of this year and I have nothing but great experiences with them. Definitely recommended!

I do not recommend RVG. I took my dog many times and many times I was misinformed. I even requested that he is not seen by a certain veterinarian because she lied to me and I had to prove her wrong. The last time I took my dog in June he had a wound, I did not know how it happened. So I rushed him in. Instead of listening to me they were trying to blame me. Come to find out it was a hotspot. They should’ve known that dogs with arthritis gets hotspots and should have told me not me find out on my own. Same day they did blood work. I called for blood results and when the doctor called me back to give me the results she had an attitude. Prior his liver levels were slightly high but the blood results showed they were at good levels. Fast forward to 11/15/2024 I took him to the ER, the ER requested his medical history, when we went over it the doctor at the ER asked did they tell you about his kidney levels, I said no! Come to find out RVG should have told me about his kidney levels was going up especially since he was an elderly dog. My fur baby passed away yesterday due to kidney failure. We could’ve start treating it and looking for symptoms not being surprised. It may be convenient in the neighborhood but not worth it. If you can travel with your fur baby to a different vet do so. The groomer there is rude and only does one type of haircut. (Used her twice and never again) The girls at the front desk are always nice and respectful but not all of them give correct information.
Excellent vets lovely front desk and quick appointments.

You’re not allowed in the room while they examine your pet. They take your pets to the back, and then you have to talk to the vet in the waiting room with everyone - except your pet. It’s moronic and I’m shocked there aren’t more reviews about this. Using covid as an excuse at this point is a lame way to hide poor care and dodge accountability.
Dr Fried and his staff truly care for their pet patients as if they are their own. We always receive the best description of the illness and the best steps to take for our pets quick recovery

We switched here from a vet in Inwood that we were unhappy with. Great choice. We saw Dr. Gad  who was fabulous. He took his time with my dog and carefully explained things for us. We recommend Riverdale Vet to everyone.

The place is clean, but the service is not good.
1) they take your pet, and do something with them without you really knowing
2) eventhough I have provided the vets with the vaccination records of my dog, they double shot him with a vaccine that he already had, again without asking me first
3) after my dog got the shots, we were not provided with a properly documented vaccination record. It was just a print out of vaccine title with no date or number of the vial, or expiration date

Sub par service  do yourself a favor go to a professional this is not it this is due to rvg putting a splint directly onto the skin I'm sorry but your supposed to put padding first then the splint you had a template from what you took off you couldn't duplicate what you saw that's just pure common sense

I can't give them enough stars!!! Everyone was so caring and knowledgeable. Our dog is anxious and can be 'dramatic' lol. He came out of the exam room relaxed.
They are open 7 days a week- which is also a huge plus!!!

Unprepared staff, sometimes rude due to lack of patience or knowledge. You ask any information, any request, any feedback, and they ask you to repeat three times when in person, and on the phone, they transfer you to every other person that …
